sentence: This project studies how the bacteria that cause leptospirosis attach to and cross layers of human endothelial cells.
This project builds an imaging and artificial intelligence platform that shows how living cells respond to drugs.
This project builds a tool that combines hospital data to find the root causes of hospital acquired infections.
This project tests whether Legionella pneumophila releases protein effectors into its culture medium when no host cells are present.
This project studies how blocking immune checkpoints changes immune cells and cancer cells in glioblastoma.
This project studies how a transcription factor in microglia contributes to Alzheimer’s disease.
This project tries to find compounds that target senescent fibroblasts to reverse cardiac fibrosis in the aging heart.
This project coordinates a team effort to advance gene editing therapeutic candidates for retinal channelopathies.
This project tries to find out whether genetic and proteomic biomarkers explain why some patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis progress rapidly.
This project models how epithelial cells and mast cells communicate in the airway during corticosteroid exposure.
This project studies how changing environmental conditions affect the growth, toxicity and life cycle of harmful algal blooms.
This project provides data analysis for research on the mechanisms of cardiomyocyte proliferation after a heart attack.
This project designs natural killer cells that target solid tumors such as brain tumors and prostate cancer.
This project tests whether obesity damages reparative cells from fat tissue so they cannot mend injured mouse microvessels.
This project screens for small molecule inhibitors of a protein and tests them in lung cancer cell lines.
This project builds a machine learning approach that uses several sensors to track sleep in nightshift workers.
This project tries to starve malaria parasites by lowering the pantothenate stores of mosquitoes.
This project engineers a three-dimensional model of the embryonic vascular niche that generates hematopoietic stem cells from pluripotent stem cells.
This project studies what drives leukemia cells to grow and develops compounds that inhibit or degrade proteins in leukemia.
This project uses deep learning and experiments to predict mRNA secondary structure and stabilities for designing stable mRNA vaccines.
